question: Niwas Praman Patra (Domicile / Residence Certificate) - Guide 3 in 2026?
q: Niwas Praman Patra (Domicile / Residence Certificate) - Guide 3 in 2026?
q_en: How to apply for Niwas Praman Patra (Domicile / Residence Certificate) via state eDistrict portal in 2026?
answer:
Sarkari Seva Overview & Guidance 2026

Niwas Praman Patra (Domicile / Residence Certificate) hetu official eDistrict portal par Citizen Login kare. Form me apni vyaktigat jankari bhare, ration card, voter ID, photo aur self-declaration form upload kare. Tehsildar/SDM level par verification ke baad 7 se 15 dino me certificate digitally signed Hokar portal par download ke liye uplabdha ho jata hai. Source: edistrict.delhi.gov.in

Aavedan Prakriya - Step by Step Process

  • Official portal https://edistrict.delhi.gov.in par visit kare.
  • Apna Mobile Number aur OTP dalkar authentication complete kare.
  • Form me zaroori jankari jaise Name, Address, Aadhaar Details, Bank Passbook bhare.
  • Scanned copies of required documents upload kare aur eKYC verify kare.
  • NetBanking / UPI / SBI ePay se prescribe fees pay kare aur acknowledgement slip save kare.

Zaroori Documents List (Required Proofs)

  • Aadhaar Card (Mobile Number Linked)
  • Voter ID Card / Domicile Certificate / Address Proof
  • Income Certificate & Bank Passbook Copy
  • Recent Passport Size Photograph

Helpline & Official Source

Kuch bhi samasya hone par official portal https://edistrict.delhi.gov.in par Grievance section check kare ya Toll-Free Number 1800-11-0001 par call kare. Source: https://edistrict.delhi.gov.in
